findings.title: Create the queued timestamp per AssignmentSource instance
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the module is imported, rather than when an `AssignmentSource` is created. Consequently, every inbound assignment handled by the same process serializes the same startup-time `queued` value, even hours or days later. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` to record each assignment's creation time.
